name: dmma_gemm2x2
desc: DMMA.8x8x4 f64 multi-tile GEMM (2x2 = 4 output 8x8 atom tiles): one warp computes D=alpha*A*Bᵀ+beta*C over a 16x16 output via 4 warp-true m8n8k4 atoms. Re-audits the C/D m<->n square-tile transpose hazard across off-diagonal output tiles (the second bug fixed for 19_tensorop_canonical). Compared to a host f64 fma-chain replica.
